title: Customs and Excise Act 91 of 1964
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Customs and Excise Act 91 of 1964'. Commencement: 1 January 1965, with s 58A on 1 April 2021. Amended as recently as Rates and Monetary Amounts Amendment Act 45 of 2024.
notes: This is the operative customs statute. It stays in force until the Customs Control Act and the Customs Duty Act commence.
